_comment: Pinned tool/PDK manifest for the `eda-sim` overlay image (issue #509).
THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every version the image bakes
or fetches. Nothing here is duplicated as a literal in the Dockerfile or in
.github/workflows/publish-eda-sim-image.yml: `docker/eda-sim/build.sh` reads
this file with jq and passes each pin as a --build-arg, and the Dockerfile's
ARGs are declared without defaults so a missing pin fails the build loudly
instead of silently baking a stale one. tests/test_eda_sim_image.py enforces
that no-duplicate-literals property so a future edit cannot reintroduce
drift. Bumping a version means editing THIS FILE (and bumping image.version).
Field guide:
image.*            identity + tag scheme of the published overlay, and the
size ceiling CI asserts (the PDK tree is NEVER baked --
see pdks.baked below).
base.*             the loom-worker base this image layers on. Owned by
rjwalters/loom, published to GHCR by its release
workflow; multi-arch (amd64 + arm64).
tools.ngspice      built from source, not apt: Ubuntu's package is older
than the `ngspice_min_major: 46` floor that
2AMLogic/gf180-sar-adc's and gf180-trng's sim harnesses
enforce. `min_major` is the floor the image asserts at
build time; `version` is what it actually builds.
`sha256` is checked before the tarball is unpacked.
tools.xschem       the schematic netlister. `commit` is the exact SHA
`tag` must resolve to -- the build fails if it does
not, so a re-pointed upstream tag cannot silently
change what is baked.
tools.ciel         the PDK version manager. ciel, NOT volare: ciel is the
maintained successor (same open_pdks build format and
CLI shape) and volare's PDK release feed stopped in
tools.klayout_tools this repo's own `klt`, baked as the DRC/LVS driver the
block repos' layout-verification stages invoke. Must be
a version published to PyPI.
pdks.*             what `eda-sim-fetch-pdk` fetches AT RUNTIME. Never
baked into the image.

image.name: ghcr.io/2amlogic/eda-sim
_version_comment: Semver for the overlay itself, independent of klayout-tools' own release
version. Bump it in the same commit as any pin change below; the publish
workflow tags the pushed image with this value plus `latest` and
_max_size_comment: ~2 GB ceiling from issue #509's hard rule, asserted by the publish
workflow against `docker image inspect --format '{{.Size}}'` of the
single-arch build. Excludes the PDK tree by construction.

_comment: Verified live against the GHCR registry API on 2026-09-09: tags
["0.19.0", "latest"], and 0.19.0 is an OCI image index carrying both
linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 manifests. Ubuntu 24.04 userland; default
user `loom` (uid 1000); already ships build-essential, git, curl, jq, gh.
Configure flags and the `min_major: 46` floor come from
2AMLogic/gf180-trng's `.github/workflows/pdk-nightly.yml` and
gf180-sar-adc's sim/toolchain.json. Batch-mode simulator only: no X11,
no readline. XSPICE is enabled because open_pdks device models may use
its extensions.
The VERSION deliberately does NOT match gf180-trng's `NGSPICE_VERSION:
46`. Re-verified live 2026-09-09: upstream has moved 46 into
`ng-spice-rework/old-releases/46/`, so the URL that workflow pins
(`ng-spice-rework/46/ngspice-46.tar.gz`) now 404s -- its nightly is
presumably surviving on an actions/cache hit and would fail cold. 47 is
the current release at the stable path, and it clears the same floor.
The sha256 above was computed from the real 13,105,136-byte tarball
downloaded on 2026-09-09, not copied from another repo.
Bumping means updating `version` AND `sha256` together here. If a
future bump 404s the same way, the tarball has almost certainly moved
to `ng-spice-rework/old-releases/<version>/` -- adjust `url_template`.
Same pin 2AMLogic/gf180-sar-adc's sim/toolchain.json carries. Tag ->
commit re-verified live against the upstream GitHub API on 2026-09-09:
refs/tags/3.4.7 is an annotated tag (3851bc5a...) dereferencing to
Same pin gf180-trng's pdk-nightly.yml uses (CIEL_VERSION). Latest on
PyPI as of 2026-09-09.
This repo's own CLI (`klt`), installed from PyPI. It brings the KLayout
Python module headless -- no GUI, no Qt, no apt package. 0.4.0 is the
latest published release as of 2026-09-09.

_baked_comment: HARD RULE (issue #509): the PDK tree is never baked into the image. A
single family is 7-9 GB, which would blow the size ceiling and couple PDK
versions to image releases. The image carries the FETCH MECHANISM (ciel +
these pins + the `eda-sim-fetch-pdk` helper); the tree lands in
$CIEL_HOME (default ~/.ciel), which callers should back with a volume or
cache mount so it survives container restarts.
_install_root_comment: ciel installs to ~/.ciel/<variant> when PDK_ROOT is unset. Leaving
PDK_ROOT unset is load-bearing -- ciel installs THERE instead if it is
set -- so the image deliberately does not export PDK_ROOT.
_families_comment: Both families pin the same open_pdks commit, which is what gf180-trng
already uses (PDK_VERSION in its pdk-nightly.yml).
DRIFT NOTE, verified live 2026-09-09 against the fossi-foundation/
ciel-releases API: the older `c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b`
commit that the still-on-volare repos pin (sky130-bandgap's sim/pdk.json,
gf180-sar-adc/gf180-pll/gf180-temp-por/gf180-ldo's sim/toolchain.json) has
NO ciel release -- both `sky130-c6d73a35...` and `gf180mcu-c6d73a35...`
404. `f6eeac7d...` resolves for BOTH families (200). So this is not a
free swap of fetch tool: a repo moving from volare to ciel also moves its
open_pdks pin, exactly as gf180-trng did. Callers that must have the old
commit can still override the pin per-invocation (`eda-sim-fetch-pdk
--commit <sha>`) or install volare into the image's writable venv.
`libraries` is the minimum set the fleet's audited harnesses actually
need: the primitive library (device models, needed for every ngspice run)
plus the one digital standard-cell library `klt synthesize` /
`klt place-and-route` map onto. The `common` tarball (device models under
<variant>/libs.tech/ngspice, and the xschem symbol library under
<variant>/libs.tech/xschem) is always fetched by ciel regardless. Fetching
the full default set instead would pull ~5 GB of unused IO/SRAM/alt-cell
libraries; `eda-sim-fetch-pdk --all-libraries` opts into that.
